name: Academy Press
source: Academy Press Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2025, group column: consolidated statement of profit or loss page 26 and five year financial summary group page 94. FY2026 kept as stored earlier and not re-verified. Every populated row ties: Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, Gross Profit less net operating cost equals Operating Profit, Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit, and EPS matches the printed Naira per share line.

rows.source_note: Net operating cost: selling and distribution expenses plus administrative expenses less credit loss reversal and less other operating income. FY2025 and FY2024 read from page 26 of the FY2025 audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, group column; the figure is positive because the panel convention here is Gross Profit less Operating Expenses equals Operating Profit. FY2023 to FY2021 withheld because the issuer five year summary prints no operating lines.
